meta.title: Deadlock Route Atlas
meta.orientation: Archmother at top; Hidden King at bottom. No additional Y flip.
meta.pathDisclaimer: Route lines show stop order. Use doors, stairs and ropes; they are not exact floor-level navigation.
meta.resourceDisclaimer: Map slots show authored locations, not current availability. Some floors overlap.
meta.economyDisclaimer: Approximate solo collection value. Normal boxes use expected drops; buffs assume successful heavy jackpots. Approach boxes and lane waves are excluded from jungle totals.
meta.resourceMerge: Latest October 12 breakable positions; matched September 30 authored data supplies floor elevations. Missing elevation remains null.
